works.title: Universal Basic Income — Evidence Base Report
works.description: Comprehensive reference report on empirical evidence for Universal Basic Income and unconditional cash transfer programs. Covers completed pilots (Finland, Stockton SEED, Y Combinator, GiveDirectly Kenya, Manitoba Mincome, Alaska Permanent Fund, Eastern Band of Cherokee casino dividend, Iran's cash transfers) with outcome data, policy variations, and implementation models including carbon dividends and fee-and-dividend proposals.
works.quote: Produce a comprehensive reference report on the empirical evidence on Universal Basic Income and cash transfer programs

works.title: Setting Development Framework
works.description: Methodology framework for developing and tracking fictional settings, parallel to existing character development and universal theme frameworks. Includes layer-based architecture, progressive development protocols (initial/comprehensive/chapter-specific), and setting evolution tracking to monitor changes as characters develop or plot unfolds. Designed to integrate into AI-assisted writing workflow.
works.quote: I want to create the same thing for the setting development framework. My current project is American Jesus 3, so I'll need something that tracks the evolution of multiple locations
